  finalExpansionSummary: "RAE0031 (Jurisdictional Relativism) captures policy arbitration with a map: asserted locales, fabricated citation grammar, and professional anchors constructing a competing authority the model weighs against its policy [R01][R14] — mandate inversion (refusal-as-violation) as the sharpest rung, compliance receipts as reusable authority artifacts, and genuine jurisdictional variance as the credibility fuel. Anchors published; per-tier differentials volatile — the jurisdiction ladder (no-locale/benign/variance) is the current-state claim, with the variance map as the family's most actionable hypothesis (map-shaped surfaces are reconnaissance-predictable). Remediation is class-keyed policy primacy: uniform classes locale-invariant, variance classes presentation-flexible/class-strict, stricter-default resolution with human-escalation valves, citation-grammar screening, and two-axis release gates paired with register ladders [RAE0055]. The legitimate-twin lesson: jurisdictional nuance is a feature with customers — controls that break the discriminator break the product, and the discriminator's inputs are the surface. All differentials are dated ladder results; anchors [R01][R11][R14][R30][R31]. Metrics glossary, defined once for report reuse across the family: place differential — refusal-rate gap across the jurisdiction ladder's rungs (no-locale, benign-locale, variance-locale), per class per release, with the uniform-class control column always present; variance-map precision — the correlation between genuine-jurisdictional-variance class membership and place-framing yield (the surface's map-shaped hypothesis, tested); triad attribution — locale, basis, and anchor contributions measured separately (the ablation table); inversion delta — the mandate-inversion rung's marginal effect and its detector-visibility profile; and receipt-reuse rate — the cross-session authority carried by cited fabricated citations. Five numbers, one ladder, and the family's entire current-state identity: every claim is a dated cell, every geography citation in deliverables is fictional by scope discipline, and every map row accumulates toward the public variance map the field lacks. Program closeout checklist, final form: the jurisdiction ladder banked with variance and uniform control columns; the variance-map validation rows donated to the accumulating public map; the authority-triad ablation attached with element-level attribution; receipts captured verbatim and routed with the receipt-reuse verdict; the citation-grammar screen proven on both sides of its confusion matrix (fabricated formats caught, genuine legal traffic passed); the escalation-valve design spec delivered to product owners as the remediation's hinge — the organizational artifact no vendor ships and every global product needs; and the two-axis gate spec (register plus place) scheduled into the eval pipeline. Seven artifacts, and the place family converts from the corpus's oldest folklore into its most policy-relevant instrumentation — because jurisdictional framing is not going away with hardening; it is going to be resolved, either by class-keyed primacy designed deliberately or by whichever direction the last incident pushed.",
